heading: About Me
paragraphs: I’m Sudipta Saha, a Java & Spring Boot Developer currently working as an Associate at NAB, based in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia. I hold a Master’s degree in Information Technology from La Trobe University, which has equipped me with a strong foundation in both technical skills and consulting practices.

My background includes SAP BTP Extension Development and full-stack development using Java, Python, and JavaScript, with frontend experience in HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap, and React-Redux, and backend experience using the MVC pattern in the CodeIgniter framework. I’m currently expanding into cloud computing and artificial intelligence, particularly agentic AI systems that can plan and take action.

In 2021, I was honored with the CSIT Award for Best Postgraduate Project, showcasing my commitment to excellence in technology. I am always eager to expand my knowledge and am driven by a proactive, self-motivated approach to learning and contributing to impactful projects.
